name: 20261105-upgrade-u6-evaluation
reason: U6 evidence cited by the change record: the near-duplicate threshold chosen on development comments (U6.5), the coarse-v1 and coarse-v2 screening comparison with its agent review (U6.4), and the U6-L live readings (benchmark off and extraction-development off at the U6.5 commit: identity, adoption-rule items against the latest accepted runs, glossary target references, report groups, near-duplicate clusters)

files.summary/u6-extraction-development-off-{m: U6-L extraction run, the same four files

files.summary/u6l-spend.json: bridge spend before and after the two runs with their doctor calls
files.provenance/: one-off scripts: u6_api_runs.sh, u5_identity.py, u5_compare.py (unchanged from U5), u6_near_duplicate_threshold.py (U6.5), u6_screening_variants.py (U6.4; imports the coarse-v1 module copy kept in the archive)
